name: Shinozaki Ayumi
source:
After the ordeals of Heavenly Host that cost Ayumi her friends, she became an illustrator as she always wanted to be. However, her art was seen as depressing and frightening, so she was usually hired to draw things that reminded her of the horrors of Heavenly Host. Because of the stress from the six years of internal turmoil and guilt, she has dark circles under her eyes.

[From [url=http://corpse-party-fanon.wikia.com/wiki/Ayumi_Shinozaki_(CPD2)]Corpse Party Fanon Wiki[/url]]
